headline: Kitchens, and the makers behind them
intro: Every kitchen in this edition was made by an independent workshop: Samji Studio in Paris and WUNSCH in the UK. We want more collaborations like these, so this edition doubles as an open call. If you make kitchens, this is what a joint project with Polygood® looks like.

cases.title: Maison Kyka
cases.headline: Terrazzo Nuovo worktops for two Paris flats
cases.body: Samji Studio, a Paris workshop that makes furniture to measure, made the worktops for two Maison Kyka apartment kitchens: one in the 7th arrondissement, one near Saint-Germain in the 6th. Both are in Terrazzo Nuovo, a pale terrazzo pattern with fine dark flecks. In the 7th it sits on timber cabinets around a black sink. In the 6th, Samji cut the front edge into a wave that echoes the cabinet handles.
cases.image_alt: Compact Paris kitchen with beige cabinets, wavy timber handles and a Terrazzo Nuovo worktop with a wave-cut front edge

cases.title: Thermoformed kitchen
cases.headline: An Emerald Ghost kitchen with a thermoformed curve
cases.body: A private client in Paris asked Samji Studio for a kitchen worktop and a table to match. Samji made both in Emerald Ghost, a flecked sea green, set against timber cabinets and herringbone parquet. Part of the work was thermoformed: Samji heated the panel until it softened, shaped it over a mould and let it cool into a curve. It is the only thermoformed kitchen in our project archive so far.
cases.image_alt: Emerald Ghost kitchen worktop and matching table in a Paris flat with a concrete ceiling, timber cabinets and herringbone parquet

cases.title: Station Road
cases.headline: A White Lollipop worktop for a Station Road kitchen
cases.body: WUNSCH, cabinetmakers in the UK, cut and fitted the worktop for this kitchen on Station Road in White Lollipop, a white ground with small flecks of colour. The flecks pick up the rest of the room: mustard-yellow fronts, pale birch ply, green glazed tiles and the reds and oranges on the open shelf. WUNSCH also photographed the finished kitchen.
cases.image_alt: Kitchen with mustard-yellow cabinet fronts, green glazed tiles, a brass tap and a White Lollipop worktop with small coloured flecks

cases.title: Rootz
cases.headline: Beyond the kitchen: tables, chairs and lights
cases.body: Rootz is a knowledge and innovation centre for the tree nursery sector in West Brabant, a place for work, meetings and research. In February 2025 All Art Design furnished it in Polygood: tables and chairs in Terrazzo Nuovo and Sapphire Terrazzo, lampshades and a chandelier in Aqua Drift. The panels form both the surface and the structure, so the furniture needs no separate frame, and the blue shades soften the light that passes through them.

partner.heading: We're looking for kitchen makers
partner.body:
We'd like to work with more kitchen studios, cabinetmakers and worktop fabricators on joint projects in Polygood.

Tell us about your workshop and the kitchens you make. We'll start with a conversation and samples of the patterns that suit your work. When a project is finished, we share it on polygood.com and in this newsletter, credited to the people who made it, as you've seen above.
